items.headline: Patience starting to run thin for head coaches in Week 11
items.description: Saturday didn't offer much to change the season's complexion, but some coaches are coming under pressure.

items.headline: Wake Forest's post-blowout jab at SMU tops college football Week 11 trolls
items.description: Wake Forest dominated SMU on the gridiron Saturday -- and added insult to injury after the game.

items.headline: Indiana embraces more aggressive offense after win over USC
items.description: Adam Rittenberg breaks down how the Hoosiers' explosive passing attack and late-game ground game could open things up for Indiana moving forward.

items.headline: Grant Wilson delivers as Indiana boosts CFP, Big Ten hopes with win vs. USC
items.description: With Grant Wilson filling in at quarterback, No. 9 Indiana ramped up its offensive attack against USC and scored its best win of the season Saturday.

items.headline: Grant Wilson throws 2 TD passes, No. 6 Indiana beats No. 15 USC 27-13
items.description: — Grant Wilson came back for his seventh college season because he wanted to win a second national championship.

items.headline: Indiana takes down USC 27-13 in pivotal Big Ten showdown
